description: This Java class defines 'HtmlMenuWrapperImage', which extends 'HtmlMenuWrapper' to provide functionality for rendering HTML menus that include images, specifically handling menu setup and rendering. It is part of the OFBiz framework's widget rendering subsystem, dealing with menu item initialization and image-related rendering.

classes.name: HtmlMenuWrapperImage
classes.description: A specialized wrapper for rendering HTML menus with images, extending 'HtmlMenuWrapper', and providing image-specific menu rendering.

methods.name: HtmlMenuWrapperImage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with specified resource, menu name, request, and response objects.

methods.name: getMenuRenderer
methods.description: Returns a new 'HtmlMenuRendererImage' object responsible for rendering the menu with image support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the menu wrapper, retrieves menu items, and associates 'WebSitePublishPoint' content entries with each menu item in the context.
